context: Evaluates correct usage of the mitt-based typed event bus (emitter) and eventSuffixes from @pascal-app/core. The candidate must use emitter.on() and emitter.off() to subscribe and unsubscribe, emitter.emit() to dispatch events, and reference eventSuffixes for dynamic event name construction.

checklist.name: emitter.on usage
checklist.description: Calls emitter.on('wall:click', handler) or similar node event key to register a listener that receives the typed payload.

checklist.name: emitter.emit usage
checklist.description: Calls emitter.emit('wall:click', payload) or similar to dispatch an event, causing registered handlers to fire.

checklist.name: emitter.off usage
checklist.description: Calls emitter.off('wall:click', handler) with the same handler reference used in .on() to correctly unsubscribe, so subsequent emits do not invoke the handler.

checklist.name: eventSuffixes reference
checklist.description: References the exported eventSuffixes constant to enumerate or validate the 8 supported interaction suffixes rather than hardcoding them.
